name: Starship
description: SpaceX's next-generation fully-reusable launch system, designed to carry 100+ tonnes to LEO. Both the Super Heavy booster and the upper stage are designed to be caught and reflown.

name: New Glenn
description: Blue Origin's debut orbital launch vehicle, New Glenn is a two-stage rocket powered by BE-4 methane engines. Its reusable first stage lands propulsively on a drone ship, and its 7-meter fairing is among the largest in the industry. As of May 2026 the vehicle has flown three times (one orbital failure on the April 2026 BlueBird mission) and is grounded after a ground-test explosion destroyed the next vehicle.
statusNote: Grounded following a static-fire test anomaly at LC-36 on May 28, 2026 that destroyed the NG-4 vehicle. Return-to-flight pending investigation. (Last verified: May 29, 2026.)
costPerLaunchSource: No firm public commercial list price; est. $70-100M range (industry)
